thread:
keisha wong: Hi team  we just completed an international surrogacy and baby was born abroad. Want to add to medical/dental/HSA. What docs do you need for a surrogacy birth outside the US? Also can I enroll now without SSN and have coverage effective on the birth date? Any payroll proration/retro rules I should expect?

alex (People Ops): Congrats, @keisha! Short answers: you can add a newborn from surrogacy as a QLE. Upload the birth record, the surrogacy agreement, and either the Consular Report of Birth Abroad (CRBA) or the child's foreign birth certificate plus a certified English translation or apostille. If the birth registration is delayed, a hospital letter + passport can suffice temporarily. Use the dependent add portal: https://benefits.redwood.com/forms/dependent-add and choose "Newborn (surrogacy)".

people-ops-bot: Reminder: 30-day QLE window for newborns. If documentation arrives late, submit an exception request with an explanation and evidence. See: https://benefits.redwood.com/qle-policy :information_source:

tara (Benefits): Carrier notes: most carriers allow enrollment pending SSN; you usually have 60 days to provide the SSN. Coverage can be effective retro to the birth date if you enroll within the 30-day window. Payroll will prorate premiums based on the coverage effective date; if the effective date is before the last payroll run we'll process a retro premium adjustment on the next paycheck. If you prefer to spread the retro hit over two pay periods, add that in the portal notes and payroll will try to split it.

keisha wong: Thanks  quick Q on translations  do translations need to be notarized or just certified? Also who do I tag if carrier follows up asking for DNA?

alex (People Ops): Certified translation with translator statement is sufficient in 99% of cases; notarization not required unless carrier asks. Carriers rarely request DNA; if they do we will coordinate and let you know next steps. Tag @tara in this thread for carrier follow-ups and DM the docs if you want us to upload.

keisha wong: Uploaded CRBA + surrogacy agreement + passport scan to the portal and noted to split any retro over two paychecks. Thanks for the help! :heart:
